accuracy.anchor: Three of five points; the failure was described without how the script handled it, and no per-agent cost (anchors: 27–30 every point with a number; 15–20 three of five; under 10 one point).

structure.anchor: Framing opened with method before the verdict; the update has no cost line (anchors: 22–25 all parts in order; 13–17 parts present but weak; under 8 problem only).

customer_relevance.anchor: Endpoint count and freeze mentioned; cost given as "a few ACU" (anchors: 16–20 auditor's numbers and constraints used; 10–13 some numbers; under 6 feature talk).

brevity_and_fluency.anchor: Framing, checkpoint-120 and objection-2 over, update under; six fillers and a 12 s pause (anchors: 11–15 segments on target, under 1 filler/min; 6–8 two or more segments off; under 4 most segments off).

recovery.anchor: Objection 1 had boundary and evidence but no offer; objection 2 had no per-agent number (capped at 5) (anchors: 7–10 acknowledge → boundary → evidence → offer held with numbers; 4–6 partial; under 3 no pattern).
